definitions.explanation: The natural agent that makes things visible; brightness from the sun, a lamp, etc.
Used metaphorically to represent hope or a positive outlook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光|ひかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{眩|まぶ}しい→まぶしい：03737_mabushii⟧。
{光|ひかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えてきた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A light became visible. / I can see hope.

examples.japanese: {光|ひかり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速|はや}さ→速い：00514_hayai⟧
⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{光|ひかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}んでいる→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: Light is streaming into the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光|ひかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光|ひかり}
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光|ひかり}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: To see hope in the future.
There is hope even in dark times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{光|ひかり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えてくれた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。

notes:
{光|ひかり} refers to light in both literal and figurative senses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光|ひかり}: sunlight

- {光|ひかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: light shines on
- {光|ひかり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}つ→放つ：10062_hanatsu⟧: to emit light
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{光|ひかり}: ray of hope

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to shine (verb)
- ⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧: bright
- ⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to sparkle
- ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧: sunlight

Note: ひかり is also the name of a Shinkansen line and train series.
